
```{r}
library(terra)
library(Rlibeemd)
library(EMD)
library(imputeTS)

source("~/SeasonalTrendsEdited/scripts/EEMD_trend_fun.r")

climate_dir <- "~/SeasonalTrendsEdited/data/TerraClimate"
out_dir <- "~/SeasonalTrendsEdited/output"

climate_stacks <- list(
  precipitation = list(
    long = rast(file.path(
      climate_dir,
      "long_season_precipitation_1997_2024.tif"
    )),
    short = rast(file.path(
      climate_dir,
      "short_season_precipitation_1997_2024.tif"
    ))
  ),

  temperature = list(
    long = rast(file.path(
      climate_dir,
      "long_season_temperature_1997_2024.tif"
    )),
    short = rast(file.path(
      climate_dir,
      "short_season_temperature_1997_2024.tif"
    ))
  ),

  solar_radiation = list(
    long = rast(file.path(
      climate_dir,
      "long_season_solar_radiation_1997_2024.tif"
    )),
    short = rast(file.path(
      climate_dir,
      "short_season_solar_radiation_1997_2024.tif"
    ))
  ),

  vpd = list(
    long = rast(file.path(
      climate_dir,
      "long_season_vpd_1997_2024.tif"
    )),
    short = rast(file.path(
      climate_dir,
      "short_season_vpd_1997_2024.tif"
    ))
  ),

  soil_moisture = list(
    long = rast(file.path(
      climate_dir,
      "long_season_soil_moisture_1997_2024.tif"
    )),
    short = rast(file.path(
      climate_dir,
      "short_season_soil_moisture_1997_2024.tif"
    ))
  )
)

para <- list(
  factor = 1,
  start = c(1997, 1),
  frequency = 1,
  ensemble_size = 100,
  noise_strength = 0.2,
  S_number = 4,
  num_siftings = 50,
  fill_value = NA,
  out.list = FALSE
)

years <- 1997:2024

eemd_names <- c(
  paste0("Residual_", years),
  paste0("TrendAccum_", years),
  paste0("Rate_", years),
  "trend_class",
  "break_time",
  "accumulated_before",
  "accumulated_after",
  "mean_rate_before",
  "mean_rate_after"
)

class_labels <- data.frame(
  ID = 1:4,
  class = c(
    "Monotonic decrease",
    "Monotonic increase",
    "Increase to decrease",
    "Decrease to increase"
  )
)

eemd_summary <- list()
breakpoint_summary <- list()
eemd_outputs <- list()

for (variable in names(climate_stacks)) {

  for (season in c("long", "short")) {

    cat(
      "\nRunning EEMD:",
      variable,
      "-",
      season,
      "\n"
    )

    x <- climate_stacks[[variable]][[season]]

    eemd_result <- app(
      x,
      fun = EEMD_trend_fun_at_pixel,
      para = para
    )

    names(eemd_result) <- eemd_names

    full_file <- file.path(
      out_dir,
      paste0(
        season,
        "_season_",
        variable,
        "_EEMD_full_1997_2024.tif"
      )
    )

    writeRaster(
      eemd_result,
      full_file,
      overwrite = TRUE,
      wopt = list(
        datatype = "FLT4S",
        filetype = "GTiff"
      )
    )

    eemd_class <- eemd_result[["trend_class"]]

    f <- freq(eemd_class)

    f <- f[!is.na(f$value), ]

    f$percentage <- f$count / sum(f$count) * 100
    f$variable <- variable
    f$season <- season

    f$class <- c(
      "Monotonic decrease",
      "Monotonic increase",
      "Increase to decrease",
      "Decrease to increase"
    )[f$value]

    eemd_summary[[paste(variable, season, sep = "_")]] <- f

    eemd_class_factor <- as.factor(eemd_class)

    levels(eemd_class_factor) <- class_labels

    class_file <- file.path(
      out_dir,
      paste0(
        season,
        "_season_",
        variable,
        "_EEMD_trend_class.tif"
      )
    )

    writeRaster(
      eemd_class_factor,
      class_file,
      overwrite = TRUE
    )

    break_time <- eemd_result[["break_time"]]

    break_time[break_time == -999] <- NA

    break_file <- file.path(
      out_dir,
      paste0(
        season,
        "_season_",
        variable,
        "_EEMD_breakpoint_year.tif"
      )
    )

    writeRaster(
      break_time,
      break_file,
      overwrite = TRUE
    )

    bp <- freq(break_time)

    bp <- bp[!is.na(bp$value), ]

    if (nrow(bp) > 0) {

      bp$percentage <- bp$count / sum(bp$count) * 100
      bp$variable <- variable
      bp$season <- season

      breakpoint_summary[[paste(variable, season, sep = "_")]] <- bp
    }

    eemd_outputs[[paste(variable, season, sep = "_")]] <- list(
      full = eemd_result,
      class = eemd_class_factor,
      breakpoint = break_time
    )

    print(f)
  }
}

climate_eemd_summary <- do.call(
  rbind,
  eemd_summary
)

climate_eemd_summary <- climate_eemd_summary[
  ,
  c(
    "variable",
    "season",
    "value",
    "class",
    "count",
    "percentage"
  )
]

write.csv(
  climate_eemd_summary,
  file.path(
    out_dir,
    "climate_EEMD_class_percentages.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

print(climate_eemd_summary)

climate_breakpoints <- do.call(
  rbind,
  breakpoint_summary
)

climate_breakpoints <- climate_breakpoints[
  ,
  c(
    "variable",
    "season",
    "value",
    "count",
    "percentage"
  )
]

names(climate_breakpoints)[
  names(climate_breakpoints) == "value"
] <- "year"

write.csv(
  climate_breakpoints,
  file.path(
    out_dir,
    "climate_EEMD_breakpoint_frequencies.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

print(climate_breakpoints)
```
